newsitem.title: GREECE: CARNEGIE HOLDS ANNUAL PRESENTATION OF GREEK FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: CARNEGIE HOLDS ANNUAL PRESENTATION OF GREEK FIRMS.

text.p: Carnegie Emerging Markets said on Friday that its annual Greek presentation was held in its offices today and was attended by various investors from the U.K. and abroad.
Gikas Hardouvelis, director of strategic planning at state National Bank gave an overview of the Greek economy at the meeting.
Deputy National Bank of Greece governor Nick Karamouzis, Gikas Hardouvelis and another National Bank of Greece officials presented Greece's largest commercial bank, it said.
Marcos Kallergis, managing director of aluminium processor ETEM, Anthony Kallergis, technical director at ETEM and Panayiotis Stratiotis its financial officer presented their firm, it added.
Maria Kuhkalani, financial director of supermarket chain Alfa-Beta Vassilopoulos, part of the Delhaize Group, spoke about her company.
The vice-president of Goody's fast food chain, Nikos Pappas, presented his firm along with Dimitris Patsouras of the Viohalco Group and Constantine Katsaros deputy general manager of Elval.
Jonathan Young, managing director of Carnegie, made the introduction at the meeting which was hosted by Mariella Porfyratos, head of the Greek desk, it said.
Elizabeth Nixon is the Greek desk's senior analyst and is assisted by Kostas Tseregounis.
